[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)

SD60-CP01.name: Gallet Revolt (Battle Spirits Mirage)
SD60-CP01.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge] (Purple/White & Proximate/Astroblazer & Cost 3 or more, "Bladra")
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Nexus with the same card name as this card, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, place one core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus's symbol is also treated as White.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Draw a card, and put two cores from the Void to this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Send two cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. Or, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

[Rush: White]
